verificationNotes: Initial serious Axe contrast finding in .activity small was reported to the root agent before product edits. Root changed the text color to #675d4d, rebuilt, and froze production. This report measures that final build.
The full pre-fix evidence is preserved under work/final-qa/v03-browser-smoke-before-contrast-fix.json and excluded from final pass counts.
No product source, photos or audio were edited by this QA agent.

Chromium reported four software-WebGL ReadPixels performance warnings. Firefox and WebKit reported no console warnings. All page/console error, HTTP failure, failed-request and external-request counts are zero.

observations: Representative cafes gallery renders the Meron image and visible branch-unconfirmed caption without clipping.
Credits modal fits the mobile viewport; operator-image reuse terms are visible and explicit. All six language variants are also covered by DOM/Axe checks.
Paradis card visibly identifies the undated original attraction and unconfirmed current operation, and shows a destination-confirmation note with no visit link.
